correctness.rationale: Each parent restriction is a coordinatewise event in the independent parent sequence; conditional parent choices remain independent and uniform among earlier surviving labels. Pruning marked leaves preserves root-to-latest depth. Exact binomial expansion of \(u^{L_n-1}\), Eulerian factorial moments and depth Bernoulli recursion yield joint coefficients. Each singleton marked-leaf event has probability (i-1)/(n-1), hence the transform-covariance identity and strict sign. The standalone extracted checker independently exhausts all trees through eight vertices and all leaf subsets and checks 695 rational assertions; infinite proof is analytic.

value.rationale: The exact marked-leaf deletion invariance identifies the entire joint law of two natural birth-tree statistics, where previous work gave separate Eulerian leaf and Stirling depth marginals. The law yields all mixed moments, an exact signed covariance for every monotone terminal-depth score, and opposite-sign comparison against the known root-degree/leaf behavior despite the depth and root degree sharing a marginal law. The same identity holds under conditioning an arbitrary selection of leaf birth dates, making this a structural finite-size theorem rather than a routine marginal calculation.
